title: March to Enemy Headquarters
front_description: The ground shakes as the Republic's massive tanks advance on the Separatist forces. Meanwhile, in the Geonosian command center, Count Dooku and his allies are feeling the heat of this sudden, Jedi attack. "We must send all asailable droids into battle!" insists Nute Gunray. But Dooku, ever the realist, senses that the game is lost. "There are too many," he states calmly.
back_description: Early concept sketch by Doug Chiang of a geonosian artillery vehicle.
